The topic of **Clinical Consequence** in this corpus addresses the direct impact of healthcare operational metrics and delays on patient outcomes. The available evidence specifically connects surgical wait times to severe negative health outcomes, emphasizing that tracking these metrics is a matter of patient survival rather than just administrative efficiency. According to the documentation for [[indikator-4x|Indikator 4x]], waiting time for an operating room leads to increased mortality and longer hospitalization periods [^src1]. 

Currently, the data for this topic is thin, consisting of a single claim tied to one specific indicator. No further details, timelines, or additional clinical consequences are available in the provided corpus.

## Claims
- Ventetid på operationsstue giver øget mortalitet og længere indlæggelsestid [^src1] (indikator-4x)
